info.title: Serialized Data API
info.description: On-chain data for trading apps - tokens, candles, token filters. Built on our own indexers. 18 EVM chains + Solana, live.

servers.description: Demo: no key needed, read endpoints, rate-limited per IP
Production: your API key in the Authorization header

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Your raw API key (not needed on the demo server).

get.description: Chains covered by the audit engine.

Full Serialized Audit verdict for a contract: safety verdict, vulnerabilities, ownership/renounce state, proxy detection, open-source status. Async-first: an already-audited token answers inline; a new one starts the audit and returns a progress status to re-poll.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` (audit covers EVM only).

get.description: Supported chains with status. Free.
Launchpad and factory keys of the registry: `factories` lists every key, `byChain` the keys the `factories=` filter of `/v1/pulse` accepts for each chain. EVM and Solana. Free.

Static definition of one market (pool): pair address, venue/DEX, base & quote token metadata, fee tier, created-at. Slow-changing - cache-friendly. A market id is simply chain + pool address: stable, unique on its venue, never reused.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

post.description: Batch twin: the static definition of up to 100 markets in one call, across chains. Response in input order, one slot per market: `{ data }`, the body of the single GET for that market, or `{ error }` for that market alone (unknown pool, malformed address), never `null`. Billed per market.

items.description: `[{ "chain": "…", "address": "…" }]` - 1 to 100 markets (pool addresses, Uniswap V4 poolIds supported), EVM and Solana mixed freely.

get.description: Live snapshot of one market, safe to poll at high frequency: last price, per-window volume, liquidity, market cap, circulating + total supply, buys/sells and unique traders per window (5m/1h/6h/24h). Buy/sell tax and the full security fields live on `/v1/token/security`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

parameters.name: windows
parameters.description: Comma-separated stat windows among `5m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`. Default: all four, the same default as `/v1/token/stats`.

get.description: Historical OHLCV for one market, addressed by pool. Same engine and intervals as `/v1/token/ohlcv` (1s to 1M), deep backfill.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: 1s|5s|15s|30s|1m|3m|5m|15m|30m|1h|2h|4h|6h|12h|1d|1w|1M (default 5m). `1w` buckets are epoch-aligned weeks (Thursday 00:00 UTC to Thursday); `1M` buckets are calendar months (UTC). `7d` and `30d` are accepted aliases; `meta.interval` echoes the canonical key.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Candles per page, 1-2000 (default 200). Honoured whenever the history allows it, however quiet the token is.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive upper bound (pagination: prev oldestTime - 1); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized. At most 1 day ahead.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive lower bound (scans stop there); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: usd converts each candle at its bucket SOL/USD rate (available on Solana); volume follows the quote, volumeToken never does

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Dense time axis (default true): a flat zero-volume candle for every bucket without a trade. `false` returns traded buckets only.

post.description: Batch twin: the candles of up to 10 markets (pools) in one call, chains mixable. `interval`, `limit`, `quote` and `fill` are shared by the lot; `endTime` and `from` are per market. Response in input order: each slot is the body of the GET (`data` plus `interval`, `count`, `oldestTime`, `newestTime`, `hasMore`, `nextEndTime`, `pools`), or `{ error: { code, message } }` for that market alone (`NOT_FOUND` for an unknown pool, `INVALID_PARAM` for a malformed address or `quote=usd` outside Solana). A slot is identical to the GET of the same market with the same options. Billed per item.

endTime.description: Unix seconds, inclusive upper bound (pagination: prev oldestTime - 1); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized. At most 1 day ahead.

from.description: Unix seconds, inclusive lower bound (scans stop there); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized.

items.description: 1 to 10 of `{chain, address, endTime?, from?}`: `address` is the pool / pair address (Uniswap V4 poolIds supported); `endTime` / `from` are unix seconds (a millisecond value is accepted and normalized), per item, so each series paginates on its own.

interval.description: Shared by the lot: 1s|5s|15s|30s|1m|3m|5m|15m|30m|1h|2h|4h|6h|12h|1d|1w|1M (default 5m). `7d` and `30d` are accepted as aliases of `1w` and `1M`; `meta.interval` echoes the canonical key. An unknown interval is refused with `400` for the whole call.

limit.description: Candles per item, 1-2000 (default 200), shared by the lot.

quote.description: `native` (default) or `usd` (Solana), shared by the lot but judged per item: an item on a chain without USD history gets its own `{ error }` slot, the others are served.

fill.description: Dense time axis (default true): a flat zero-volume candle for every bucket without a trade. `false` returns traded buckets only. Shared by the lot.

get.description: Ranked traders of a single market (pool) over a rolling window: net PnL in native and USD, tokens and native bought/sold, open position, average entry, first/last trade, and dev/sniper/pro-trader badges. Same engine as Token Top Traders, scoped to one pool. EVM and Solana, one shape.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

get.description: Trade tape of one market: recent + historical, time-bounded, cursor pagination, optional participant filter. Each trade carries a stable id, timestamp (ms), price, size, side, maker and tx hash.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

parameters.name: fromAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: toAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 7 days ahead). A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: washFilter
parameters.description: Keep only wash-tagged or only organic transactions (solana only)

post.description: The batch twin of Market Data: poll up to 100 markets, across chains, in one request instead of a fan-out of single calls. `windows` applies to every market of the call. Response in input order, one slot per market: the same shape as `/v1/pool/data`, or `{ error: { code, message } }` for that market alone (`NOT_FOUND` for an unknown pool, `INVALID_PARAM` for a malformed address), never `null`, so one bad market never costs you the rest of the lot. Billed per market.

markets.description: 1 to 100 of `{chain, address}` pools, across chains. Billed per market.

windows.description: Comma-separated stat windows among `5m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`, applied to every market. Default: all four, the same default as `/v1/pool/data`.

post.description: Small native-price arrays for list rows: one call for up to 100 markets, each `{chain, address}` so one lot can span chains. The response is keyed by pool address, oldest to newest. Timeframes 1m|5m|30m|1h|24h|7d. An unknown pool returns `[]` - we never invent data. For token-level sparklines (the best pool resolved for you, curve history stitched in), use `POST /v1/token/sparklines`.

markets.description: 1 to 100 of `{chain, address}` pools, across chains. Billed per market.

post.description: The tape of up to 200 markets in a single call, since a timestamp - grouped per market, per-market row cap. One request replaces a full polling fan-out.

markets.description: List of `{chain, address}` pools (up to 200 per call).

from.description: Only trades at/after this time (unix MILLISECONDS, at most 24h back; a value in seconds is rejected with 400). Page the per-market tape for history.

get.description: Live USD prices of every chain's native coin, with per-symbol freshness (`updatedAt`, `stale`) - you always know how fresh a price is. These are the live rates the spot-priced USD fields of the API use (Solana: the on-chain SOL/USDC rate, refreshed every 10 seconds); Solana trade and candle USD figures use the rate at trade time, see `meta.usdBasis`.

Axiom-style launchpad lifecycle columns: `new` (created under 24h), `bonding` (active curves, sorted by bonding %), `graduated` (migrated or virtually-graduated, last 7 days). ~90 launchpads tracked natively across 18 EVM chains, bonding thresholds per factory.

parameters.name: isOG
parameters.description: first token with this ticker on the chain

get.description: Every tradable market, paginated: filters by chain, sort by trending (relevance), volume, market cap or creation time, per-window stats on every row, cursor pagination. The discovery primitive - poll it to detect new markets.

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: CSV of public chain ids (1-8). sortBy=createdAt serves ONE chain per call (indexed walk) - fan out per chain.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: `trending` (default), `volume`, `marketCap` or `createdAt`. `trending` is the relevance ranking: 24h activity weighted by real participation, so wash-traded markets rank below organically traded ones with the same figures. `volume` is strictly ordered by the gross USD volume of `window` (default 24h: `volume24hUsd` descending). trending/volume/marketCap rank within each chain's own universe (top 300 by 24h volume plus top 100 by 1h volume, named in `meta.universe`).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Rank window for `sortBy=volume`: `5m`, `1h`, `6h` or `24h` (default `24h`). Not accepted with the other sorts (`trending` is a 24h relevance).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `meta.nextCursor`. Pins the computation each page was cut from, so a walk started within the last minute never skips or repeats a market.

get.description: Low-latency token search: exact address (EVM hex, Solana base58, pool addresses) or free-text name/symbol (trigram). Covers BOTH families: `chain=solana` or `chain=evm:<id>` restricts; no chain searches EVM and Solana in parallel and merges by USD liquidity. Results carry price, liquidity, market cap, 24h volume and 1h/24h price change.

Full token snapshot: price (native + USD), market cap & FDV (sanity-capped), liquidity (+ATH), best pool (the token's main market: the deepest of the pools where it is the priced asset, measured on both sides of the pool, the same market as the first row of /v1/token/pools), launchpad state (bonding progress, graduation), deployer, 24h stats, metadata & socials.

post.description: Full-detail batch twin: up to 25 `{chain, address}` items (EVM and Solana can be mixed in one call), response array in input order with per-item `{error}` slots. Billed per item.

get.description: Every token deployed by a wallet, with a verdict on each (`active`, `migrated`, `rugged`, `abandoned`) and an aggregate risk read on the deployer: totals per status, graduation success rate, risk level, first and last deploy. Pass `address` to evaluate the deployer BEHIND a token (we resolve it), or `wallet` to query a deployer directly.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address - its deployer is resolved first. Required unless `wallet` is given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1-100. Default 50. `meta.truncated` tells you the stats only describe the returned page.

get.description: Top holders with position size, share of supply, full PnL (realized + unrealized), buy/sell volumes, behavioral labels and named entities (exchanges, funds - the "Coinbase" signal). EVM and Solana.
Socials, description, images, dex-paid status. POST twin on the same path for batches (≤100, billed per item).

post.description: Batch twin: the metadata of up to 100 tokens in one call, EVM and Solana mixed freely. Response in input order, one slot per item: `{ data }`, the body of the single GET for that token, or `{ error: { code, message } }` for that item alone (unknown token, malformed address), never `null`, so one bad item never costs you the rest of the lot. Billed per item.

get.description: Chart-ready candles from 1s to 1M. Token-wide by default (the pool we price the token from, tracked across a bonding-curve migration), or an explicit set of up to 50 pools. Wick-outlier clamping and candle connecting included. On Base, the forming candle includes preconfirmed (flashblocks) swaps ~2.5s before block commit.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to aggregate; default: the pool we price the token from, tracked across a bonding-curve migration.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: 1s|5s|15s|30s|1m|3m|5m|15m|30m|1h|2h|4h|6h|12h|1d|1w|1M (default 5m). `1w` buckets are epoch-aligned weeks (Thursday 00:00 UTC to Thursday, the standard weekly bucket); `1M` buckets are calendar months (1st of the month 00:00 UTC). `7d` and `30d` are accepted as aliases of `1w` and `1M`; `meta.interval` always echoes the canonical key.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Candles per page, 1-2000 (default 200). Honoured whenever the history allows it, however quiet the token is.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive upper bound (at most 1 day ahead; a millisecond value is accepted and normalized). Paginate back with the previous `meta.oldestTime - 1` while `meta.hasMore` is true.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive lower bound (scans stop there); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: `native` (default) or `usd` (Solana) - usd converts each candle at its bucket's SOL/USD rate from our in-house minute-grade price history (monthly candles use the median of the month's daily rates). `volume` follows the quote; `volumeToken` (units of the token) is never converted.

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Dense time axis (default true): a flat zero-volume candle for every bucket without a trade. `false` returns traded buckets only.

post.description: Batch twin: the candles of up to 10 tokens in one call, chains mixable in the same lot. `interval`, `limit`, `quote` and `fill` are shared by the lot; `endTime`, `from` and `pools` are per token, so every series keeps its own pagination. Response in input order: each slot is the body of the GET (`data` plus its own `interval`, `count`, `oldestTime`, `newestTime`, `hasMore`, `nextEndTime`, `pools`), or `{ error: { code, message } }` for that token alone (unknown token, malformed address, `quote=usd` on a chain without USD history). A bad item never costs you the rest of the lot. Billed per item.

pools.description: CSV of pool addresses (≤50); default = the pool we price the token from

endTime.description: Unix seconds, inclusive upper bound (pagination: prev oldestTime - 1); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized. At most 1 day ahead.

from.description: Unix seconds, inclusive lower bound (scans stop there); a millisecond value is accepted and normalized.

items.description: 1 to 10 of `{chain, address, pools?, endTime?, from?}`. `pools`: optional CSV of up to 50 pool addresses to aggregate (default: the pool we price the token from, tracked across a bonding-curve migration). `endTime` / `from`: unix seconds (a millisecond value is accepted and normalized), per item, so each series paginates on its own with the `oldestTime - 1` of its slot.

interval.description: Shared by the lot: 1s|5s|15s|30s|1m|3m|5m|15m|30m|1h|2h|4h|6h|12h|1d|1w|1M (default 5m). `7d` and `30d` are accepted as aliases of `1w` and `1M`; `meta.interval` echoes the canonical key. An unknown interval is refused with `400` for the whole call.

limit.description: Candles per item, 1-2000 (default 200), shared by the lot.

quote.description: `native` (default) or `usd` (Solana), shared by the lot but judged per item: an item on a chain without USD history gets its own `{ error }` slot, the others are served.

fill.description: Dense time axis (default true): a flat zero-volume candle for every bucket without a trade. `false` returns traded buckets only. Shared by the lot.

get.description: The markets of a token - rank 1 is the exact pool the token endpoint prices from, then every other market ranked by 24h volume and liquidity.
Cheap price tier for bots and tickers: price, market cap, liquidity. Nothing else.

post.description: Batch twin - up to 100 tokens in one call, one SQL round-trip. Response in input order; missing tokens come back as per-item `{error}` slots.

get.description: Per-family security fields. Solana: mint/freeze authority state (on-chain truth). EVM: holders count, top-10 concentration (CEX-custody excluded), dev/snipers/bundlers holdings %, token burn %, buy/sell/transfer tax (on-chain simulation), dexPaid. null always means unknown, never a fake zero.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id (`solana`: LP burn and lock analysis is served on Solana).

post.description: Per-family security fields. Solana: mint/freeze authority state (on-chain truth). EVM: holders count, top-10 concentration (CEX-custody excluded), dev/snipers/bundlers holdings %, token burn %, buy/sell/transfer tax (on-chain simulation), dexPaid. null always means unknown, never a fake zero.

items.description: Up to 100 of `{chain, address}`, across chains. Response array is in input order with per-item `{error}` slots. Billed per item.

post.description: Small native-price arrays for token list rows: one call for up to 100 tokens on one chain. We resolve each token's best pool for you and stitch bonding-curve history onto it, so a freshly graduated token draws one continuous line. The response is keyed by token address, oldest to newest. Timeframes 1m|5m|30m|1h|24h|7d. An unknown token returns `[]` - we never invent data. To spark specific pools, across chains, use `POST /v1/pools/sparklines`.

chain.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` or `solana`. One chain per call.

tokens.description: 1 to 100 token addresses on `chain`. Billed per token.

get.description: Windowed volume, buy/sell counts and volumes, price change - 5m/1h/6h/24h in one call.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to restrict the windows to; default token-wide (every pool of the token).

parameters.name: windows
parameters.description: Comma-separated stat windows among `5m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`. Default: all four, the same default as `/v1/pool/data`.

post.description: Batch twin: the windowed stats of up to 25 tokens in one call, EVM and Solana mixed freely. `windows` applies to the whole call, `pools` is per token. Response in input order, one slot per token: `{ data }`, the body of the single GET for that token, or `{ error }` for that token alone, never `null`. Billed per token.

pools.description: CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to scope the stats. OMIT for token-wide stats across every pool (Mobula-aligned default).

items.description: `[{ "chain": "…", "address": "…", "pools": "…" }]` - 1 to 25 tokens, EVM and Solana mixed freely; `pools` optional per token (CSV of up to 50 pool addresses of that token; omit for token-wide).

windows.description: Same as the GET, applied to every token: comma-separated windows among `5m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`. Default: all four.

get.description: Ranked traders of a token, from our own PnL fold (per wallet and token): realized PnL in native and USD, tokens bought/sold, open position, average entry, win rate over closed positions, first/last trade. Lifetime by default (`timeframe=all`), or any rolling window from `1h` to `30d`. Default sort is `pnl` on both families; `sortBy` accepts `pnl`, `bought`, `sold` or `txns`.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: `all` (default) ranks over the token's lifetime; `1h`, `4h`, `1d`, `7d` or `30d` ranks over a rolling window. On a window, `realizedPnlNative` is the net native cashflow over the window and `winRatePct` is `null`.

get.description: Real-time trade tape. `maker` is the trader behind the swap, resolved through relays, solvers and smart accounts, with isProTrader/isSniper badges on every row. On Base, preconfirmed (flashblocks) trades appear ~2.5s before block commit, flagged per row. Filters: side, USD/native/token amount ranges, date range, makers (POST twin, up to 2000). Cursor pagination.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to restrict the tape; default token-wide (every pool of the token).

parameters.name: fromAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: toAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 7 days ahead). A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: washFilter
parameters.description: `washOnly` or `organicOnly` - filter by the per-transaction wash badge (solana; every row carries `isWash`).

post.description: The same tape as the GET, taken as a JSON body: use it to filter by `makers[]` (up to 2000 trader addresses, far beyond what a URL can carry) or to send a long filter set. Same filters, same rows, same cursor pagination. One token per call, billed as one request whatever the number of makers: this is a filter variant, not a batch.

pools.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to restrict the tape; default token-wide (every pool of the token).

nativeMin.description: Minimum trade size in the native unit.

nativeMax.description: Maximum trade size in the native unit.

fromAt.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

toAt.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 7 days ahead). A value in seconds is rejected (400).

washFilter.description: `washOnly` or `organicOnly` - filter by the per-transaction wash badge (solana only).

makers.description: Trader addresses to keep, up to 2000. Omit for the full tape.

get.description: Current billing cycle of the calling key: plan, credits used, limit and remaining, request count. Free.

Requests and credits per endpoint over the last `days` days, heaviest first: which routes consume your budget. Stream time appears alongside REST routes, as `WS /v1/stream` (connection minutes) and `WS <channel>` (subscription minutes per channel). Free.
Time series of your requests and credits over the last `days` days, bucketed at `15m`, `1h`, `6h` or `1d`: the graph of a usage dashboard. Free.

Every position a wallet has fully exited: total bought and sold (USD and native), realized PnL in absolute and percent, buy/sell counts and last trade time. The realized counterpart of `/v1/wallet/positions` - the realized PnL of every position lands in exactly one of the two. EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` or `solana`. Omit for all EVM chains.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated token addresses (1-50) to scope the response to: the realized PnL of those tokens, without paging the whole wallet.

post.description: Batch twin: up to 20 wallets per call, response array in input order. Each slot is `{ data, hasMore, oldestAt }`, the body of the single GET for that wallet, or `{ error }` when that wallet failed, so one wallet never fails the others. `limit`, `offset` and `sort` apply to every wallet of the call. Billed per wallet.

wallet.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58)

chain.description: Public chain id. Omit for all EVM chains.

items.description: `[{ "wallet": "…", "chain": "…" }]` - 1 to 20 wallets, EVM and Solana mixed freely; `chain` optional (omit for all EVM chains).

offset.description: Rows to skip per wallet. Default 0.

get.description: Total wallet value (USD) as a time series over a chosen window - the equity curve behind every portfolio chart.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, default now. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

get.description: Where a wallet got its first funds: the earliest native transfer that funded it - funder address, timestamp, transaction and amount, with an entity tag (exchange, bridge…) when the funder is known. The primitive behind insider and sybil heuristics.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

post.description: Batch twin: the first funder of up to 100 wallets in one call (at most 20 of them on Solana), each item naming its chain. Response in input order, one slot per wallet: `{ data }`, the body of the single GET for that wallet (`data: null` when no funder is known), or `{ error }` for that wallet alone. Billed per wallet.

chain.description: Public chain id (required: the first funder is read per chain).

wallet.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58)

items.description: `[{ "chain": "…", "wallet": "…" }]` - 1 to 100 wallets, `chain` required on each (the first funder is read per chain); at most 20 Solana wallets per call.

get.description: Realized PnL of a wallet: daily curve plus summary (total realized, win rate, trades, wins/losses). Omit `chain` to combine every EVM chain; `chain=solana` for Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id. Omit for all EVM chains combined.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` (default) or `all`. A period keeps the UTC days from now minus that many days through today, both inclusive: `7d` spans 8 calendar days, `1d` yesterday and today.

post.description: Batch twin: up to 20 wallets per call, response array in input order. Each slot is `{ data }`, the body of the single GET for that wallet (daily curve plus summary), or `{ error }` when that wallet failed, so one wallet never fails the others. `period` applies to every wallet of the call. Billed per wallet.

wallet.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58)

chain.description: Public chain id. Omit for all EVM chains.

items.description: `[{ "wallet": "…", "chain": "…" }]` - 1 to 20 wallets, EVM and Solana mixed freely; `chain` optional (omit for all EVM chains).

period.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` (default) or `all`.

get.description: Every position of a wallet with entry and exit prices, cumulative amounts and PnL: amount held, USD value, average entry and average exit, bought and sold totals, realized + unrealized + total PnL, trade counts and first/last trade timestamps. Optional native and stablecoin balances read on-chain, pagination. EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated token addresses (1-50) to scope the response to - positions and summary cover only those tokens.

parameters.name: minValueUsd
parameters.description: Only positions whose `amountUsd` reaches this floor. Default 0.05 (dust removed); pass 0 to lift the floor. A traded position whose value is unknown is always listed; `meta.summary` still covers every position of the wallet.

parameters.name: includeNative
parameters.description: Also list the wallet's native coin balance (and its wrapped form) as rows of `kind` `native`, read on-chain, at face value, counted in `summary.totalValueUsd`. On Solana: SOL plus wrapped SOL. Default false.

parameters.name: includeStables
parameters.description: Also list USD stablecoin balances (`kind` `stable`), read on-chain, at face value, counted in `summary.totalValueUsd`. Default false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-500. Omit to receive every row.

post.description: Batch twin: up to 20 wallets per call, response array in input order. Each slot is `{ data, summary, hasMore }`, the body of the single GET for that wallet, or `{ error }` when that wallet failed, so one wallet never fails the others. `minValueUsd`, `includeNative`, `includeStables`, `limit` and `offset` apply to every wallet of the call. Billed per wallet.

wallet.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58)

chain.description: Public chain id. Omit for all EVM chains.

items.description: `[{ "wallet": "…", "chain": "…" }]` - 1 to 20 wallets, EVM and Solana mixed freely; `chain` optional (omit for all EVM chains).

minValueUsd.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet. Default 0.05.

includeNative.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet.

includeStables.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet.

offset.description: Rows to skip per wallet. Default 0.

get.description: Who is behind an address: display name, avatar, ENS / Basename / .sol, bio, social accounts (Twitter, Farcaster, GitHub…), follower counts, sources, pro-trader flag - plus `linkedWallets`, other addresses of the same person (cross-wallet identity clusters). Built on our identity graph of 7.6M+ labeled wallets across EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58).

post.description: Batch twin: up to 100 addresses per call, response array in input order. Each slot is `{ data }` where `data` is the body of the single GET (`{ profile, linkedWallets }`), the same slot shape as every other batch endpoint. A wallet without a known identity comes back as `{ data: { profile: null, linkedWallets: [] } }` (identities are harvested continuously - retry later, never assume permanent).

items.description: `[{ "address": "…" }]` - 1 to 100 items, EVM and Solana mixed freely.

get.description: Trade history of a wallet, newest first - multihop-deduplicated (one event per transaction, token and side; never doubled volumes). Paginate with the opaque `cursor` from `meta.nextCursor` on both EVM and Solana: exact keyset pagination that never skips or repeats a trade. The intermediate legs of routed swaps (the wSOL, stable or quote a route passes through) are excluded by default - pass `includeRoutingHops=true` to see them, flagged `isRoutingHop`. Wash/MEV rows are NOT filtered and carry the `isWash` badge - consumers choose; `isWash` is `null` on EVM (no equivalent stamp).

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque resume token from `meta.nextCursor` - exact keyset pagination on both EVM and Solana, no skip or duplicate.

parameters.name: beforeAt
parameters.description: Upper bound, unix MILLISECONDS: trades strictly older. A value in seconds is rejected (400). Prefer `cursor` for exact pagination.

parameters.name: includeRoutingHops
parameters.description: Also serve the intermediate legs of routed swaps, flagged `isRoutingHop`. Default false.

post.description: Batch twin: up to 20 wallets per call, response array in input order. Each slot is `{ data, hasMore, nextCursor, oldestAt, usdBasis }`, the body of the single GET for that wallet, or `{ error }` when that wallet failed, so one wallet never fails the others. Every item names its `chain` (the trade tape is per chain) and may carry its own `cursor`: each wallet paginates independently with the `nextCursor` of its slot. `limit`, `beforeAt`, `fromAt` and `includeRoutingHops` apply to every wallet of the call. Billed per wallet.

wallet.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58)

chain.description: Public chain id (required: the trade tape is per chain).

items.description: `[{ "wallet": "…", "chain": "…", "cursor": "…" }]` - 1 to 20 wallets, EVM and Solana mixed freely; `chain` required; `cursor` optional, the `nextCursor` of that wallet's previous slot.

beforeAt.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet: upper bound in unix MILLISECONDS, trades strictly older. Ignored for an item that carries a `cursor`.

fromAt.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet: inclusive lower bound in unix MILLISECONDS.

includeRoutingHops.description: Same as the GET, applied to every wallet. Default false.

get.description: Token in/out history of a wallet: deposits, withdrawals, plain transfers - timestamp (ms), token, amount, direction, counterparty, tx hash. The reconciliation primitive next to `/v1/wallet/trades`.
